first-round-capital._note: Two artifact classes came out of the 2010-2011 logo wall, where First Round rendered every company name as an image and its own upload filenames are the only text the era leaves behind (decisions.md D-T5). The FILENAME VARIANTS are fixed upstream in sources/logo-era-names.json (63 entries, applied by scratch/fix-logo-names.py to the parsed wayback years), so the rebuild produces the real slug and name rather than 'birchboxsmall' or 'smartlingverysmal' — a source fix rather than a merge, which also spares the published surface the junk names. What stays here is `merges` for five genuine identity changes and `rejects` for the ACQUIRER marks the same page carried beside its exits: Google, Microsoft, Intuit, Adobe, eBay and Facebook are not First Round positions, and a name-matching layer will confidently mislabel them if they stay.
